item.description:
### Added - **Stop and reply to Amp from your phone and watch.** Perch now talks to Amp directly, so Stop works and replies arrive even mid-turn. Restart Amp once after updating. - **Amp conversations on your phone.** Tap an Amp session to read it and watch new messages arrive. - **Amp cloud threads on the list.** Threads Amp runs in the cloud show up beside your local ones.
### Changed - An Amp "finished" notification now shows the start of Amp's reply.
